name: Post-Meeting Minutes & Action Items
description: Comprehensive follow-up summarizing meeting discussion, agreed decisions, individual responsibilities, and deadlines.
structure: Appreciation for time and participation
Executive summary of core discussion points
Action items table with owner and deadline
Upcoming milestone / next sync date
Polite closing and invitation for clarifications

name: Sales Discovery Follow-up & Next Steps
description: Engaging sales follow-up addressing customer pain points, confirming requirements, and proposing next demo or proposal review.
structure: Thanking lead for sharing challenges and goals
Recap of key challenges identified (pain points)
How our proposed solution fits their timeline and scale
Agreed next milestone (demo / proposal review)
Direct call-to-action for scheduling

name: Gentle Follow-up Nudge / Pending Decision
description: Courteous, polite check-in when a client or lead hasn't responded to a previous proposal or inquiry.
structure: Friendly, non-intrusive greeting
Reference to previous conversation / proposal sent
Highlighting key value or answering potential pending questions
Low-friction call to action (e.g. quick 5-min call or reply)
Warm closing

name: Project Milestone & Status Update
description: Structured project status update highlighting completed deliverables, current blockers, and upcoming milestones.
structure: Overall health status (Green/Amber/Red)
Key accomplishments achieved this period
Open blockers and mitigation steps
Target dates for next deliverable sign-offs

name: Contract Renewal & Executive Review
description: Professional renewal proposal recapping past value delivered, current options, and early sign-off incentives.
structure: Review of annual achievements and value delivered
Outline of renewal package and expansion opportunities
Special incentives / timeline details
Meeting request to finalize paperwork

name: Urgent Action Required / Blocker Escalation
description: Direct, clear escalation when missing inputs or approvals are blocking a critical delivery deadline.
subject_template: URGENT: Input required for {project_name} delivery deadline
structure: Clear immediate statement of the blocker
Impact on the launch date / milestone
Exact action required from recipient
Deadline by which resolution is necessary
Contact information for immediate sync
